deterministicHarness.adosProcessBoundary: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService; only its ImplementerRuntimeProvider (the OS process spawn) is a deterministic fake, per authoritative requirement 23. Real preparation validation, trusted-policy check, safe-command check, structured requirements assembly, and durable execution/result/run-status record creation all run.

projectA.registration: canonical ProjectRegistrySeedData entry (Active, Company), registered through ProjectRegistryService with a local repository/worktree binding applied via applyLocalProjectRepositoryBindings; the bound worktree path is the actual repository the verification runs in (process.cwd()), never an invented path and never persisted here

cascade.note: With all four controls enabled, evaluateSelectedProjectBacklogSuggestionsForAutoAccept() synchronously runs the sanctioned Spec 146 FR-016 trigger. Each transition is attributed to its owning policy's per-evaluation audit counter, not by disabling a stage.

executionDurableRecord.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService outcome persisted into controller state (externalProjectAdosExecutions / externalProjectAdosExecutionResults / externalProjectAdosRunStatuses)

projectB.registration: canonical ProjectRegistrySeedData entry, registered through the same ProjectRegistryService, left in its seeded not-connected state; used only for second-project isolation assertions

adosRun.note: Role and candidate-ownership assignment come from durable ADOS state, not a UI or evidence label. The durable record is .agent-workflow/runs/148-autonomous-company-operations-end-to-end/ados-run.json (gitignored, worktree-absolute paths). An allowlist of its stable identity fields is mirrored into the tracked, sanitized specs/148-autonomous-company-operations-end-to-end/ados-run.sanitized.json; absolute paths and volatile per-cycle lifecycle fields (status, nextStage, implementationFailure, implementationRecoveryAttempts, implementationRecoveryBlock) are deliberately excluded because committing this evidence advances HEAD and would immediately stale any frozen lifecycle snapshot. tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts the agentAssignment below is transcribed unchanged from ados-run.sanitized.json, and - when the durable file is present in the worktree - that the sanitized copy still matches durable ADOS state field-for-field across the allowlist. The real ADOS execution-path semantics (preparation validation, structured request, durable run status records) are additionally exercised by the real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService in the deterministic harness.

agentAssignment.expectedReasonPerRequirement10: explicit operator preference for Claude implementer

externalSafetyBoundary.note: This implementation runtime does not publish, merge, deploy, or mutate GitHub (execution policy; the same boundary Specs 142-147 declare). ADOS runs full configured validation and an independent Codex review against the exact candidate HEAD after every implementation handoff, including the handoff that adds this evidence. This tracked artifact deliberately does not freeze a per-candidate validation result or review decision: committing it advances HEAD, so any frozen verdict is immediately stale. The live verdict lives in the durable sources named in shaAlignment.durableSources and is gated by tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js. Only publication/merge/deploy/GitHub mutation remain the human-only gate.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. They are durably available in the sources below and resolved at validation/review time, not transcribed here: a SHA literal committed into a tracked file is stale the moment the commit lands (it changes HEAD). tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads those durable sources when present and asserts candidate == validated == reviewed alignment from them; it also asserts the enforcement gate directly so the check holds in a clean checkout where the durable files are absent.
shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication via tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus (exactTargetMatch gate). validated == reviewed alignment is additionally cross-checked from candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json when those durable files are present in the worktree.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus (exactTargetMatch gate); exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and durable-source validated == reviewed cross-check

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). Human-only gate; not reached at implementation handoff. This is a standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.

completionState.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService execution/result status persisted into controller state

recursiveLoop.byConstruction: Spec 148 adds no production code and therefore introduces no new trigger; existing cooldown/capacity/idempotency gates (Specs 144-147) are unchanged.

officeLifecycleRepresentable.note: Spec 148 changes no view code; these lifecycle stages are already rendered by existing office modules.
stages: Complete -> merged/completed reflects actual ADOS result

portfolioTruthfulness.note: Spec 148 changes no portfolio code. Spec 140 project-scoped, read-only, no-leak derivation is covered by src/features/city-view/scene/PortfolioOperationsService.test.ts (active/attention/idle/completed/disconnected mapped independently; global run does not contaminate another portfolio item; per-policy summaries do not mutate state).
